location: Western Forests — Old-growth elven forests west of the fort.
rewardEnvelope: the pay is plain coin, and the road's yield goes to the company
stakeIfLost: If the company fails, the fort loses its only leverage to hold or exchange wanted fugitives, letting them vanish across the border.
arrival: was waiting at first light · said the whole of it standing
OPPOSES: warden · keep the corridor open for those she will not hand over

bible.goal: to seize and deliver the runner who runs the old smuggler's route through the Western Forests to the fort.

relevantLore.name: Reed-veil Hollow
relevantLore.blurb: A wet bowl of reed camps where the forest meets the slow river.

arcStep: Search Fenbar Landing, the mooring the fort named, for recent signs the runner used the docks
